Image Custom Fields — Edit

Create a custom field for uploading images.

Image fields allow attaching photos, logos, or other visual content to records.

Name

Enter the name of this image custom field. This label appears on forms and reports.

Image fields allow users to upload photos, diagrams, logos, or any visual information.

Position

Enter a position number to control the display order. Lower numbers appear first.

Image fields typically work well at the bottom of forms to avoid pushing other fields down.

Width

Enter the maximum width in pixels for displaying the image. Default is 400 pixels.

Images larger than this width will be scaled down proportionally to fit.

Height

Enter the maximum height in pixels for displaying the image. Default is 400 pixels.

Images taller than this height will be scaled down proportionally to fit.

Placement

Select where this image field should appear. You can assign it to multiple forms or line items.

Common uses: product photos on inventory items, signatures on customers, receipts on expenses.

Description

Enter help text that appears below the field. This guides users on what images to upload.

Specify acceptable formats (JPG, PNG) and purpose, like 'Upload product photo' or 'Attach receipt image'.

Exclude from copying or cloning

Check this box to prevent images from being copied when duplicating records.

Enable this for unique images like signatures or receipts that shouldn't be duplicated.

Locked for manual editing

Check this box to prevent this field's value from being edited by users.

This is typically used when custom field is updated by extension rather than users directly.

Show custom field on printed documents

Check this box to show the uploaded image on the View screen after saving.

Images will display at the specified width and height dimensions on the View screen.

Inactive

Check this box to deactivate this image field. It won't appear on new forms but existing data is preserved.

Previously uploaded images remain accessible in existing records and reports.
